_readme: ISOT's own strike list. Edit on GitHub and commit: the app reads it on every open. The official register (via /api/strikes) is merged in automatically; add an entry here only to correct its wording or to add something it misses. kind: local | general | rail | air. scope: turin | region | national. date and end: YYYY-MM-DD. Past entries disappear on their own.

strikes.title: General strike, public and private sectors
strikes.note: All day. Buses, trams, metro and trains may stop outside guaranteed hours.

strikes.title: EasyJet cabin crew
strikes.note: 24 hours. Check your flight with EasyJet before going to the airport.

strikes.title: ENAV air traffic staff (4 h) and EasyJet cabin crew (24 h)
strikes.note: Flights across Italy may be delayed or cancelled. Check with your airline.

strikes.title: General strike (USB): buses, metro, trains, flights, taxis
strikes.note: Friday 30 Oct. GTT buses, trams and metro may stop outside the guaranteed hours (usually 6:00–9:00 and 12:00–15:00, check gtt.to.it). Trains from 21:00 Thu 29 to 20:59 Fri 30. Flights and taxis all day.

strikes.title: Italo trains (9:01–16:59)
strikes.note: Italo high-speed trains may be cancelled 9:01–16:59. Trenitalia is not affected.

strikes.title: General strike (CGIL), public and private sectors
strikes.note: Friday 20 Nov, all day. Transport may run reduced service: check gtt.to.it and your train before leaving.

strikes.title: GTT and train strike (CUB / SGB)
strikes.note: Saturday 21 Nov: GTT buses, trams and metro may stop all day outside the guaranteed hours (check gtt.to.it). Trains from 21:00 Fri 20 to 20:00 Sat 21.

strikes.title: Air traffic control (ENAV)
strikes.note: Sat 21 Nov 13:00–17:00 across Italy, and all day Sun 22 Nov at Milano Malpensa. Check your flight with the airline.
